publication.edition: English translation with introduction and notes; Sanskrit text c. 8th-3rd century BCE

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed the early Upanisads are taught through dialogues between teacher and student (e.g., Uddalaka and Svetaketu in the Chandogya), progressing by questioning, analogy and experiment toward abstract claims about self and reality.

limitations: The Upanisadic 'tat tvam asi' and similar formulae are translation-sensitive; claims here concern dialogue structure, not lexical equivalence.
